title: Infflux
description: infflux.com Infflux is an international IT consulting and software development company specializing in digital transformation, custom software, cloud solutions, AI/ML and DevOps for enterprise clients. With approximately 50 to 150 employees and estimated revenue of 5 to 20 million dollars, it operates through a global delivery model spanning the US, Latin America and Europe. Its technology stack covers AWS, Azure, Java, Python, React, Kubernetes and TensorFlow. Services include custom development, data engineering, UI/UX design, QA automation and IT staff augmentation. It serves clients across finance, healthcare, retail and technology sectors. The company leverages nearshore delivery from Latin America with offices in Colombia, Mexico and Argentina for cost-effective engineering talent.
